statement: CoreWeave signed a multiyear, multibillion-dollar expansion with Hudson River Trading that will deliver Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 and HGX B200 systems on Spectrum-X Ethernet.
why: A new multibillion-dollar committed contract adds to neocloud backlog and pulls through Nvidia's newest rack-scale systems and networking.

impact.mechanism: Committed multiyear capacity spend by a non-AI-lab buyer converts into orders for next-generation Nvidia systems and fabric.

evidence.excerpt: HRT will be among the first CoreWeave customers to receive wide-scale access to Nvidia's newest chips

confidence.basis: Company press release with no disclosed dollar amount; not a filing.
